_README: Submissions the intake notifier should NOT flag (e.g. internal chapter business that doesn't belong on the public calendar). Match by title (case-insensitive substring) in ignoreTitles, or by exact submission _date timestamp in ignoreDates. The two ignoreDates below are the 2026-06-03 platform-test submissions ('Test' and the 'DIAGNOSTIC … (ignore)' diagnostic, both ΧΛΛ); they have no real curated event to match, so they're suppressed by timestamp to keep the daily pre-check from firing on them forever. The third ignoreDates entry is the 2026-07-03 'Corks & Ques' (ΝΠ) submission: that event took place Sat Oct 3, 2026 and was intentionally removed from events.ts, so it's suppressed by timestamp (not title) so that a future year's Corks & Ques submission is still picked up.
